control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70, check LEFT then RIGHT and turn 20° or call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: curve left on black, curve right otherwise.

likely_intent.description: In a tunnel, keep away from its walls: when a wall comes in front of its left or right side, turn away so it doesn't hit it.

branches.outcome: dim light: it checks the side obstacle sensors
bright light: it goes to driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first LEFT sees an obstacle; second RIGHT sees one

branches.outcome: LEFT sees a wall: it turns left 20°
LEFT sees nothing and RIGHT sees a wall: it turns right 20°
no side wall: it calls driveInTheDark
dim light: it drives forward at 30 %
a wall is ahead: it stops

input_dimensions.dimension: what is in front of the robot's left and right
which side a tunnel wall comes in front of
which side a tunnel wall comes in front of
what is ahead in bright light
what is ahead in bright light

scenarios.coded_response: It drives forward at 30 % without end while the light is below 70 %.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a straight tunnel, in dim light, with nothing in front of its left or right side.
scenarios.trigger: The program runs in the tunnel.
scenarios.title: Goes through a straight tunnel without hitting its walls
assumptions: You didn't say where in the tunnel it should go: the test aims at the far end.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It goes through the tunnel without touching its walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It turns 20° left when LEFT sees a wall, and 20° right when RIGHT sees one, then checks again.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a tunnel that bends, in dim light, and a wall comes in front of its left or right side.
scenarios.trigger: A side obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Turns away from a tunnel wall
assumptions: You didn't say which way it should turn, only that it must not hit the wall.
The test aims at getting through the bend.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It doesn't hit the tunnel wall and gets through the bend.

scenarios.coded_response: It goes to stopAtWall and stops while FRONT sees an obstacle.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in bright light, with a wall ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The front obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: In bright light, stops at a wall ahead

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left on black and curves right otherwise.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in bright light, on a line, with no wall ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then not black, again and again.
scenarios.title: In bright light, follows the line

uncertainties: The sentence doesn't say what the robot should do in bright light or on a line, so those parts have no expected behaviour.
When LEFT sees a wall the program turns left, and when RIGHT sees one it turns right: that may turn it into the wall instead of away from it.
In dim light the program never checks the front sensor unless the light comes back above 70 % near an opening.
